card.name: The start of ADULT in dosing
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word adult(s), such as AD before ULT, mostly in capitals in dosing text. It also fires on words just before adult, such as unlike or young.

modes.label: AD in capitalized ADULT
modes.description: The opening piece AD of ADULTS or ADULT, often in headings pairing adult with pediatric or children.

modes.label: Word just before adult
modes.description: A word that leads into adult or adulthood, such as unlike, young, or average.
modes.example: PEDIATRIC PATIENTS UN<<LIKE>> ADULT PATIENTS, PEDI

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the word as adult or adults, including the Chinese forms for adult.
card.plain: It fires when the word adult is about to be completed, usually in dosing headings that contrast adults and children.
